coupling: The CPIX introduction defers PlainValue decoding until the shared exit path, while the later XML text allocation cleanup releases the DOM early for documents without DRMSystemList. With only the first change, the DOM still owns the node when decoding runs; with only the second, PlainValue is decoded before the early release. Together the deferred lookup dereferences a freed XML node. Repair requires coordinating the producer lifetime and the deferred consumer across the commits.
